cases.setup: CREATE TEMP SEQUENCE rule_ticks; CREATE TEMP TABLE rule_event(n bigint, unused bigint DEFAULT nextval('rule_ticks')); CREATE TEMP TABLE rule_output(ordinal bigserial, n bigint, m bigint, payload text); CREATE TEMP VIEW rule_view AS SELECT * FROM rule_event; CREATE RULE view_route AS ON INSERT TO rule_view DO ALSO INSERT INTO rule_output(n) VALUES(NEW.n); CREATE RULE route AS ON INSERT TO rule_event DO INSTEAD NOTHING
cases.sql: WITH input AS (SELECT nextval('rule_ticks') AS n FROM generate_series(1,3)) INSERT INTO rule_view(n) SELECT n FROM input
cases.query: RESET ROLE; SELECT json_build_object('rows', (SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(r)) FROM (SELECT n,m,payload FROM rule_output ORDER BY ordinal) r), 'event', (SELECT json_agg(n ORDER BY n) FROM rule_event), 'next', nextval('rule_ticks'))

cases.sql: WITH input AS (SELECT nextval('rule_ticks') AS n FROM generate_series(1,3)) INSERT INTO rule_event(n) SELECT n FROM input
